nodes.label: Project Profound Video Topics: Research and Ranking
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 of the video brief (2026-11-03): 26 researched topics scored and ranked with archive evidence; #1 topic gets a production script.

nodes.label: Weighted Topic Scoring Method (D/A/E/S/U/P)
nodes.rationale: Each topic scored 1-10 on Demand, Archive strength, Emotional pull, Shareability, Uniqueness, Production ease; weighted total = 0.25D + 0.20A + 0.20E + 0.15S + 0.10U + 0.10P. Demand and evidence weighted highest because a video nobody searches for or the archive cannot back is a bad bet.

nodes.label: Semantic Search ~40-Hit Cap Limitation
nodes.rationale: The retrieval RPC returns at most ~40 hits per query regardless of --k (HNSW default candidate list), so semantic counts are a floor showing a pattern exists, never prevalence; structured fields and exact-phrase counts carry scale claims.

nodes.label: 6,454 Confirmed NDE Videos (fresh pull 2026-11-03)
nodes.rationale: nde_vids.isNde = clear_nde, up from 6,304 in the 2026-09-08 atlas; fresh pull used for every structured count because the archive grew.

nodes.label: nde_analysis Structured Fields and Exact-Phrase Counts
nodes.rationale: Core elements, entities, journey sequences and content-safety flags plus exact_phrase_search_punctuated RPC counts used for prevalence claims.

nodes.label: Content-Safety Flags (suicide, self-harm, child death, distressing, medical graphic)
nodes.rationale: Per-topic flag rates across semantic-hit videos guide clip selection from the clean majority and sensitivity handling.

nodes.label: UAP Corpus (8,394 UFO accounts)
nodes.rationale: Cross-searching NDE and UAP testimony is a gap no single-testimony channel can fill.

nodes.label: Market Snapshot: Breakout Videos (2026-11-03)
nodes.rationale: YouTube breakout videos and comment threads used as demand evidence; commenters ask whether a specific person was met, whether the dying are alone, second chances, and chaplain/hospice stories.

nodes.label: Kerr et al. 2014 End-of-Life Dreams and Visions (J. Palliative Medicine)
nodes.rationale: 88% of 59 hospice patients reported at least one end-of-life dream or vision, mostly of deceased relatives.

nodes.label: Greyson 2010 Peak in Darien Experiences
nodes.rationale: Seeing dead people not known to have died; widely cited by skeptics and believers.

nodes.label: #1 Who Comes to Meet You When You Die
nodes.rationale: Weighted 9.30 (rank 1). Only topic at the top on both demand (DOAC 4.58M) and archive strength: 1,972 of 6,454 code a deceased relative; grandparents 674, mother 339, father 338. Holds counter-evidence (unknown deaths, met no one) and fits Tom's origin story.

nodes.label: #2 The Life Review: Feeling What You Made Them Feel
nodes.rationale: Weighted 8.55 (rank 2). life_review core element in 3,167 of 6,438 (49.2%); empathy from the other person's side.

nodes.label: #3 "What Did You Learn?" The Question They're Asked
nodes.rationale: Weighted 8.35 (rank 3). 104 semantic moments in 84 videos; no coded field; each question wording reported separately.

nodes.label: #4 "It's Not Your Time": Who Decides You Come Back
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.95 (rank 4). choice_to_return in 5,037 of 6,438 (78.2%); forced_return in 1,536 journey sequences.

nodes.label: #5 What Children See When They Die
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.70 (rank 5). 623 heuristic child-experiencer matches, 351 aged 12 or under; most are adults recalling.

nodes.label: #6 "Dying Doesn't Hurt": Why They Lost the Fear of Death
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.70 (rank 6). Fear of death falls in 5,893 of 6,295 transformation analyses; must not suggest death is desirable.

nodes.label: #7 What the Dying See Before They Go (Deathbed Visions)
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.65 (rank 7). Hottest adjacent topic but archive material is second-hand, so folded into the #1 script as the cold open.

nodes.label: #8 The Tiny Kindness That Mattered Most
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.60 (rank 8). Most actionable version of the life-review story; fits Tom's Integration Station format.

nodes.label: #9 Seen From the Ceiling: What They Shouldn't Have Known
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.60 (rank 9). out_of_body in 83.6%; veridical level 185 Exceptional, 553 High; ties to book Chapter 1 (The Snickers Bar).

nodes.label: #10 Jesus, Krishna or No One: Whose Heaven Is It?
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.60 (rank 10). religious_figure entity in 2,534 of 6,454 (39.3%); counts by tradition need manual coding.

nodes.label: #11 Shared-Death Experiences: When the Living Go Partway
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.50 (rank 11). experience_type sde in 173 videos; bridge between NDEs and deathbed visions.

nodes.label: #12 The Atheists Who Came Back
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.40 (rank 12). Tom's target reader is the spiritual-but-not-religious skeptic; avoid conversion framing.

nodes.label: #13 Do Pets Wait for Us?
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.40 (rank 13). 177 videos code an animal entity; rarer than people hope.

nodes.label: #14 The Relatives They Didn't Know Had Died
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.35 (rank 14). Peak in Darien cases; only a handful clear (Keith Thompson, Eben Alexander); a 5-10 case video, not a statistic.

nodes.label: #15 Hell, the Void, and the Way Out
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.25 (rank 15). 250 distressing journeys; Touching The Afterlife is 47% distressing; lead with data and resolution.

nodes.label: #16 Signs After Death
nodes.rationale: Weighted 7.00 (rank 16). experience_type adc in 77 videos; risk of drifting into mediumship claims.

nodes.label: #17 The Hardest Part Is Coming Back
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.75 (rank 17). Under-served aftermath topic; 190 videos score zero transformation.

nodes.label: #18 "I Chose This Life": Pre-Birth Memories
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.70 (rank 18). No coded field; morally fraught (victim-blaming risk).

nodes.label: #19 Love vs Fear: NDEs and UFO Encounters Compared
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.65 (rank 19). Loving beings 63.8% of NDE entity encounters vs 1.0% UAP; fear 3.0% vs 24.1% (cached cross-domain coding).

nodes.label: #20 Time Doesn't Exist There
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.60 (rank 20). time_distortion in 3,795 of 6,438 (58.9%); keep physics talk as curiosity.

nodes.label: #21 Aliens Inside Near-Death Experiences
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.60 (rank 21). Non-human beings in NDEs and NDE-plus-UAP hybrids; uniqueness 10 because no other channel can cross-search both corpora.

nodes.label: #22 After a Suicide Attempt: What They Were Shown
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.35 (rank 22). Production ease 4: needs safe-messaging guidelines and clinician review; 13.6% distressing journeys.

nodes.label: #23 Colors That Don't Exist Here
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.25 (rank 23). Ineffability; weak standalone demand, better as a segment.

nodes.label: #24 They Came Back Different: Intuition, Electronics, Abilities
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.20 (rank 24). Psychic/expanded perception domain in 43.3% of transformation analyses.

nodes.label: #25 They Were Shown the Future
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.20 (rank 25). future_visions in 726 of 5,685 journey sequences; precognition is the least-endorsed Greyson item.

nodes.label: #26 Born Blind, They Saw
nodes.rationale: Weighted 6.10 (rank 26). Thin first-person evidence: exact phrase 'blind from birth' in 27 videos.

nodes.rationale: 4,584,038 views; hottest adjacent topic.

nodes.label: What Nobody Tells You About Death | The Living Feel It Too (The Why Files)
nodes.rationale: 1,990,856 views; shared-death experiences reached a mainstream mystery channel.
